title: Migrate from GitLab to GitHub with GitHub Enterprise Importer
summary: Migrations from gitlab.com and GitLab Self-Managed to GitHub Enterprise Cloud with GitHub Enterprise Importer (GEI) are now generally available.[^c-9976154a9c] You can now self-serve these migrations using GEI and the gh gl2gh command-line extension.[^c-9d82b0e07f]

title: Triage role can bypass issue creation restrictions
summary: If your repository restricts issue creation to collaborators only, users with the triage role can now create issues.[^c-a0a2cf534a] Previously, the restricted setting only allowed users with write access to create issues.[^c-33bae0c4d3] With this update, trusted contributors with the triage role are also included.[^c-a1c57ce89d]

title: Trigger Copilot automations with comments
summary: You can now create Copilot cloud agent automations that run when an issue comment or pull request comment is created.[^c-41a43c9740]

title: Enterprise team specialization for managed settings
summary: Enterprise administrators can now customize managed settings by targeting enterprise teams with itemized configuration files.[^c-1ae9b608be] Large enterprises can scale governance without bottlenecking every configuration change through central administrators or one-size-fits-all policies.[^c-228bd7fe99] Teams gain the flexibility to adapt Copilot to their workflows while staying within the boundaries you’ve defined.[^c-48e4deb506]

title: Customize the reasoning level for Copilot cloud agent
summary: When you delegate a task to GitHub Copilot cloud agent, you can now set the reasoning level for models that support it.[^c-b54408b0a0]

title: How the GitHub legal team used Copilot CLI to streamline their workflows
summary: Learn how to build tools to simplify how you work—without writing a single line of code.[^c-4c75af0a90] Whether you are just starting out or are not in a technical role at all, you likely already have the skills you need to build your own tools.[^c-bed5770676]

title: Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack
Customize Dependabot pull request branch names
summary: You can now customize the branch names Dependabot creates for pull requests.[^c-d6f18c00ed] New pull-request-branch-name options in .github/dependabot.yml let you set a prefix and maximum length, choose segment and word separators, set letter case, or define a custom template using placeholders.[^c-e9d39d8f60]

title: CodeQL 2.26.2 adds Swift 6.3.3 and Kotlin 2.4.10 support
summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code.[^c-9fa526aa31]

title: Code coverage automatic enablement in Code Quality settings
Upcoming deprecation of GitHub Spark on github.com
summary: Beginning August 4, 2026, GitHub Spark no longer accepts new users or allows the creation of new apps.[^c-5233793720] Existing users can continue to access GitHub Spark until August 31, 2026 to export apps they’ve already created.[^c-fb1055ef08] Apps you’ve already deployed will continue to work after GitHub Spark is retired.[^c-eac9fc3f43]

title: Retiring the Copilot Billing Preview app
Customize code scanning default setup at scale
summary: You can now apply your own configuration file to code scanning default setup, using the new github-codeql-config-file repository property.[^c-0dc05fcb9e]

title: Agents window
summary: The Agents window gives you a dedicated space to start and monitor multiple agent sessions.[^c-904f722fab]

title: Side chats with /btw
summary: When you want to ask a question without interrupting the current turn, you can open a side chat by typing /btw in the chat input.[^c-a30ada8a11] The side chat shares the context and prompt cache of your primary chat, so you can ask questions about the current turn.[^c-dd53ef896f] Similarly, you can select text in a chat response to ask contextual questions about that response.[^c-5b8b1b5020]

title: Terminal output reflow
summary: Expanded terminal output in Chat reflows to the available width as the view is resized.[^c-fec321fe6b] Previously, output used a fixed width, which caused lines to wrap too early and left unused space in wider views.[^c-f3d6fc2fc7]

title: Dictation onboarding and customization
summary: The built-in dictation converts speech to text in chat inputs, editors, and terminals.[^c-a4a33fe5bc] When you use dictation for the first time, an onboarding experience helps you verify the selected microphone before you start.[^c-3ddc6757e3]

title: Markdown diffs in the hybrid Markdown editor (Experimental)
Better dictation for terminal commands
summary: Terminal dictation applies shell-aware cleanup, so spoken commands preserve shell syntax.[^c-c48a297843] For example, saying "git commit dash m hello world" produces git commit -m "Hello World" instead of inserting the words literally.[^c-b1887e4686] Select the active microphone button to stop recording.[^c-448c580cfa]

title: New deprecations in this release
summary: The ChatAgentHostEnabled policy is removed, so administrators can no longer centrally disable the agent host through policy.[^c-cb810053e0]

title: How we took malware advisories beyond npm
summary: GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm.[^c-0cdcf65ece]

title: A guide to slash commands in the GitHub Copilot app
summary: Go beyond chat in the GitHub Copilot app with these slash commands.[^c-b99b46dd4b]

title: Kimi K3 is now available in GitHub Copilot
summary: Kimi K3, an open-weight model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-7df59382f7] The model shows frontier-level abilities on agentic coding with highly cost-effective pricing.[^c-8e97221327] Kimi K3 is hosted by GitHub on Fireworks AI.[^c-d2a1445fba]

title: Set pull request limits at the organization level
summary: You can now set pull request limits at the organization level.[^c-66c84436a5] Pull request limits let you define how many open pull requests a user without write access can have at one time.[^c-20685b5315] If a user reaches that limit, they must close or merge an existing pull request before opening another.[^c-7e0643fc2b]

title: MCP allowlists in enterprise managed settings
summary: Enterprise owners can now centrally control which Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers GitHub Copilot clients are allowed to run by using the new allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers keys in enterprise managed settings.[^c-81877a34b5] Approve the MCP servers your developers depend on and block untrusted or non-compliant ones across your enterprise.[^c-4544625c16]

title: GitHub Code Quality no longer adds Copilot as a reviewer
summary: Enabling GitHub Code Quality on a repository no longer creates a ruleset that automatically requests a code review from GitHub Copilot on your pull requests.[^c-097ee0d806] In repositories that already have that ruleset, we’ve turned off the settings we enabled.[^c-8658147739]

title: “Relates to” issue relationship in public preview and multi-select fields is generally available
summary: GitHub is making it easier to connect related work and manage multiple field values across issues and projects.[^c-9175484617]

title: Copilot usage metrics API adds agent app activity
summary: Since agent apps arrived on GitHub, teams have been able to run agents from partners like Claude and Codex directly in their GitHub workflows.[^c-8c78a06ae5] The Copilot usage metrics API now reports that activity, broken out by individual agent.[^c-cd8785f8a8] The usage metrics API does this in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.[^c-becfe5e2e5]

title: Copilot code review effort levels are generally available
summary: Lite and Balanced effort levels for GitHub Copilot code review are now generally available.[^c-7949bca734]

title: Copilot impact dashboard adds a return on investment section
summary: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes a “Potential return on investment” section that connects what you spend on Copilot to the pull request output you get back.[^c-3c9154ac22]

title: Enterprises can now install third-party GitHub Apps
summary: Enterprise owners can now install public GitHub Apps created outside their enterprise on their enterprise account.[^c-657d53e9cb]

title: Agent Terrarium: Bringing AI agents to life
summary: An open-source desktop companion app, this weekend project questions whether working with agents should simply feel transactional.[^c-9876f14dff]

title: Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java
summary: Enterprise Java developers have a new superpower—drive GitHub Copilot from idiomatic Java code with annotations, virtual threads, and more.[^c-d7c53a47de] Java developers no longer have to rely on Java framework-specific approaches to drive AI from their enterprise apps.[^c-44637c5f5c] While it is true that Langchain4j empowered developers by disintermediating specific AI vendors, you still had a dependency on Langchain4j.[^c-82d0d6a5de]

title: GitHub billing in India now supports automatic recurring payments
summary: Customers in India can now use eligible saved credit cards for automatic recurring payments on monthly and annual GitHub bills.[^c-28f2da864d]

title: Custom thread subscriptions are being deprecated

From coder to orchestrator: How agents shift the role of a developer
summary: Developers are owning more of the delivery system around code, not just code itself.[^c-47392ec3b7] Join us during GitHub Universe to meet other devs, learn something new, and explore what’s next.[^c-3986a5f368]

title: Per-model token breakdown in the usage report
summary: You can now see a per-model breakdown of the tokens behind your AI credits in the usage report.[^c-1ff323f92f] For each model, the AI usage report shows the input, output, cache read, and cache write tokens alongside the AI credits it consumed.[^c-e106c27cda] Before, the report showed AI credits without the token detail underneath them, so it was hard to explain a charge or find ways to bring it down.[^c-deab20e501]

title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash available in GitHub Copilot
summary: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, Microsoft’s latest small-tier coding model, is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot.[^c-cb824b4dc2] Building on MAI-Code-1-Flash, it adds native vision support for image understanding and delivers improvements across coding quality, instruction following, tool use, and performance.[^c-5d62e2f297]

title: Automatically migrate branch protection rules to repository rulesets
summary: You can now convert your existing branch protection rules to repository rulesets directly from your repository settings.[^c-c42539421e]

title: Copilot memory and Ollama in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 release candidate
summary: GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) 3.22 is now available and introduces new capabilities across the platform.[^c-ad1ff221e6]

title: Today I will… manage Git Submodules without leaving the IDE
summary: If you’ve worked with Git submodules for any length of time, you probably have a love-hate relationship with them.[^c-715d6d14a7]

title: Your contributors are AI-first now. Is your project?
summary: AI contributors are already in your queue.[^c-01992d543e] AutoGPT maintainer Nicholas Tindle shares the repo instructions, gates, and boundaries that keep maintainers in control.[^c-bfcef9e00d]

title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Write your first prompt
summary: Learn how to write your first prompt in the GitHub Copilot app, choose the right context and model, and start your first task with confidence.[^c-1a4eec213a] Opening a new AI tool can feel a little like staring at a blank page.[^c-6fff007423] You know you want help with something, but figuring out exactly what to ask can be its own task.[^c-3cfcb2849d]

title: GitHub availability report: July 2026
summary: In July, we experienced eight incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.[^c-605de72a64] The GitHub Actions incident on Thursday, August 6, was unacceptable in both its impact and particularity of its duration.[^c-9b1ac8ca24] Availability continues to be our top priority across all of GitHub.[^c-6ad4888bac]

title: Rule insights for organizations in public preview
summary: The rule insights dashboard is now in public preview at the organization level.[^c-0301da86ff] You get a visual, high-level view of how GitHub evaluates and enforces your GitHub repository rulesets, so you can spot trends and report on governance without stitching data together by hand.[^c-b16694a87e] You can now view rule insights across every repository in your organization in one place.[^c-98f350126b]

title: Agent Plugins 1.0 in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app
summary: You can now build a plugin once and use it across all compatible agent clients.[^c-c8b0ebe6a5]

title: Support for the Agent Plugins standard
summary: Plugins bundle agent customizations into something you can install in one step.[^c-a55492ff96] The catch has been that every agent tool expected its own layout, so publishing the same skill and MCP server to several tools meant maintaining a separate package for each.[^c-d03c640ce5] Agent Plugins 1.0 replaces those per-tool layouts with one open standard, and VS Code was part of its launch on August 6 along with other agent clients.[^c-8023a5595b]

title: Mix Anthropic and Copilot models in Claude sessions
Open the Agents window without GitHub sign-in (Experimental)
summary: The Agents window used to open with a GitHub sign-in prompt you could not dismiss.[^c-5905b8d09f] That blocked anyone whose machine can't reach github.com or anyone who doesn't interact with GitHub.[^c-662aa52f19] Users with Claude already configured with an API key who don't need GitHub sign-in had this extra step.[^c-835f351eb6]

title: Sticky scroll for prompts
summary: When you scroll through a long conversation, you can lose track of which prompt a response belongs to.[^c-92c7c3f1d8] The prompt you have scrolled past now stays pinned to the top of the chat, similar to sticky scroll in the editor.[^c-0f3ae6e02b] The pinned prompt shows its position in the conversation.[^c-23fb84128f]

title: Auto-reload HTML files in the integrated browser

summary: The GitHub Universe session catalog is live.[^c-065c7ea6b7] Explore interactive workshops, community talks, demos, and panels.[^c-3666305f32] Plus, register before August 19 to save $300.[^c-66746839cc]

title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model, is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot.[^c-9e42ccdcf2] From our early testing, the model has made improvements in web and app development and agentic coding workflows over it’s previous version.[^c-08b3adc368] The model also delivers improvements in code quality, final-output presentation, codebase research, and verification during complex coding tasks.[^c-fda9156c0d]

title: Block users from comments in personal repositories
summary: You can now block or unblock users directly from comments on pull requests and issues in repositories owned by personal GitHub accounts.[^c-08d440fa94]

title: License data quality improvements
summary: GitHub now uses package registries like npmjs.org and PyPI to determine license information for software components in the dependency graph.[^c-db31148c80]

title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 10
summary: From new models and portable plugins to smoother agent workflows, this week’s updates make GitHub Copilot more flexible across editors, the command line, and the Copilot app.[^c-599542c701]

title: How to bring your software delivery workflow into GitHub with agent apps
Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot
summary: Grok 4.6, xAI’s latest reasoning model, is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot.[^c-1aa54cce7f]

title: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
summary: OAuth apps can now request a short-lived token during the user authentication flow.[^c-50b2a7ce77] If an app opts in, they get an access token that lives for eight hours and a refresh token that’s valid for six months.[^c-4eb6617a1e] When the access token expires, the app uses the refresh token to get a new token pair.[^c-b4b91a1262]

title: How canvases make agentic workflows visible, steerable, and cost-efficient
summary: Chat is great for intent, but agent work gets lost in the scroll.[^c-035cc6e8b4]

summary: Building on our self-service credential revocation experiences for incident response, you can now take token-type and user-specific actions to deauthorize and revoke user credentials during a security incident.[^c-d46a1e4ac5]

title: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
summary: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings for plugin governance, MCP server access, OpenTelemetry, and permission modes.[^c-91daa8ce0c] Administrators can now apply consistent controls for everyone on your enterprise’s Copilot plan.[^c-375b5e0290]

title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work
summary: If you’re juggling multiple Copilot sessions, use the My work pane to track what’s in flight, what’s done, and what’s next.[^c-0d500fad53]

title: Track organization code quality trends
summary: The organization-level Code Quality dashboard now includes a Trends tab that shows how code quality has changed across your repositories over time.[^c-d8e90646b2] Instead of a point-in-time snapshot, you can see whether open findings are trending up or down and which repositories are driving the change.[^c-15d3db2043]

title: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
summary: CodeQL 2.26.3 adds JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue source modeling and improves the accuracy of several GitHub Actions queries.[^c-69d39ccd71]

title: Grid layout for chats in a session
summary: Keep related conversations visible by arranging chats in horizontal or vertical groups.[^c-6b6b9f5949] Drag chats or subagent chats into a group to compare results or monitor work side by side.[^c-617c6fc379] VS Code restores the chat-group layout and focus when you return to the session or reload the window.[^c-46eefb867a]

title: Improvements to the side pane layout
summary: The single-pane layout keeps session details and editors in a shared tab bar next to chat.[^c-e048b59566]

title: Prompt timeline
summary: Long agent sessions can make it difficult to find earlier prompts and identify which ones changed files.[^c-0035625021] The Agents window includes a timeline in the transcript gutter.[^c-db9309db9d] Each dot represents one of your prompts, and the highlighted dot marks your current position.[^c-7648815e36]

title: Find in chat
summary: Finding information from earlier in a long conversation previously required scrolling through the transcript.[^c-c09815dd12]

title: Close other editors from a tab
summary: Keep one editor open without using the tab context menu.[^c-2daa49b231]

title: Open HTML files in the integrated browser by default
summary: If you often preview local HTML files instead of editing them, set the integrated browser as their default editor.[^c-a15d804368]

title: The August 17 outage, and the work ahead
summary: An update on the August 17 outage and the steps we’re taking to improve reliability.[^c-80dd70cbe7] On August 17, GitHub experienced an outage that lasted 7 hours and 47 minutes.[^c-d40c5d2a4a]

title: Track GitHub Code Quality enablement changes in the audit log
summary: GitHub Code Quality now writes an audit log event whenever someone enables, disables, or changes its settings on a repository.[^c-6ddc91c36c]

title: Separate GitHub Actions path for GitHub Code Quality
summary: A dedicated workflow path for code quality CodeQL actions workflows is now generally available.[^c-647ddf0901] Your workflow run history and your Actions usage reports now tell GitHub Code Quality runs apart from GitHub code scanning runs.[^c-a8bac78919]

title: Code scanning adds a mitigated alert dismissal reason
summary: You can now dismiss a code scanning alert with the reason Mitigated when a vulnerability remains in the code but external controls, such as a web application firewall or network policy, mitigate its risk.[^c-044c533c3a]

title: Windows 11 arm64 VS2026 image generally available
summary: The Windows 11 arm64 image with Visual Studio 2026 is now generally available on standard and larger GitHub-hosted runners.[^c-cd36084c48]

title: Pinning saved views to the repository issues sidebar is generally available and more
Better tools for managing blocked users
summary: Managing blocked users is now faster and clearer for personal accounts and organizations.[^c-3d7dbee5f1]

title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
summary: The GitHub integration in Slack now brings the agentic capabilities of GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app into Slack in public preview.[^c-43cb36666f] You can work with @GitHub to plan changes, investigate problems, and hand off coding tasks from the conversations where your team coordinates work.[^c-a54d10bd33] GitHub is also a launch partner for Slack Code, a new type of channel designed for agents.[^c-0e5a9fad4a]

title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
summary: Turn a Microsoft Teams discussion into a collaborative agent session everyone can see and help direct.[^c-3d65158e41] Mention @GitHub in a channel, thread, or direct message to start a GitHub Copilot cloud agent session.[^c-2281178b85] Anyone in the conversation can ask questions, add context, and help plan or steer the work.[^c-7a35be1bc9]

WikiKB: a fast, repository-native knowledge base for people and agents
summary: WikiKB is an efficient, transparent, and explicitly curated knowledge base layer for humans and agents, built on the GitHub repository wiki.[^c-38d3152b97]

title: Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good.

summary: The best AI in Visual Studio is the AI you can bring with you.[^c-8f288bb2d6] Developers don’t work in a single-model world anymore.[^c-508ea13cd0] You might reach for one model for everyday coding, another for a domain-specific problem, and an approved model for work that must stay within your organization’s governance boundaries.[^c-3a8088d981]

title: How to evaluate LLMs before production

summary: You can now configure push rules more granularly by exempting specific file paths, so a rule applies everywhere in scope except the paths you choose.[^c-a2c7f5f1c3] Path exceptions are in public preview.[^c-ac512733c2] Push rules give you strong control over what enters a repository.[^c-0c2c1c3a4e]

title: Block users directly from security advisories
summary: You can now block a user directly from a security advisory page in public repositories owned by either an organization or a personal account.[^c-7ea05716ea]

title: GitHub Copilot app Customize tab is generally available
summary: GitHub Copilot is more useful when it works with the tools, knowledge, and workflows your team already relies on.[^c-693b569da5] The new Customize tab in the GitHub Copilot app brings MCP servers, plugins, skills, and canvases together in one place.[^c-160790cd17] Explore featured customizations, browse by type, and find new ways to tailor Copilot to how you and your team work.[^c-594f4df61c]

title: Rule insights dashboard generally available
summary: The rule insights dashboard is now generally available at both the repository and organization levels.[^c-29115b8254] You get a visual, high-level view of how GitHub evaluates and enforces your GitHub repository rulesets, so you can spot trends and report on governance without stitching data together by hand.[^c-af2e6578c4]

title: Visual Studio August Update – Work Smarter Across Models and Branches
GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Automate Dependabot pull request triage
summary: Managing library updates can be tedious at times.[^c-790595bf5c] Learn how the GitHub Copilot app can handle this type of repetitive task.[^c-25ab58c8f5]

title: GitHub Apps can now access enterprise billing data
summary: Enterprise owners can now grant a GitHub App access to enterprise billing data.[^c-9a5e8c7bee] When you create or configure a GitHub App, you can select the enterprise billing permission and choose one of two levels: read or read and write.[^c-40ce495ad6] Previously, the only way to read usage or manage budgets and cost centers through the API was a personal access token belonging to an enterprise owner or billing manager.[^c-e9e96f19e3]

title: Global model policy generally available
summary: In July, we announced a default model policy for generally available GitHub Copilot models on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.[^c-a78ecc13dc] Starting today, we’re gradually rolling out enforcement of the policy through September 1, so it will take effect at different times for different enterprises.[^c-b894589f17] Previously unconfigured and new generally available models will inherit the global policy state.[^c-a1c8091649]

title: Enterprise-managed settings now support autoUpdate for plugin marketplaces
summary: You can now opt individual plugin marketplaces into automatic updates by setting autoUpdate: true on an extraKnownMarketplaces entry in enterprise managed settings.[^c-e2e97c3be7] Supported clients automatically check the marketplace and update installed plugins sourced from it, reducing manual maintenance for organization customizations.[^c-d46d2f8dce] The marketplace must still be permitted by the effective strictKnownMarketplaces allowlist.[^c-aeaa45fe01]

title: The Visual Studio Debugger agentic workflow gets a test-driven upgrade
summary: A few months ago, we introduced a new guided agentic workflow in the Visual Studio Debugger Agent designed to help you move from a bug report to a verified fix without spending your morning guessing where to begin.[^c-0b2bcd0e36]

title: Continue external agent sessions in VS Code
summary: The Sessions list in VS Code can now show recent Copilot or Claude agent sessions that you created in other applications.[^c-135fa22593] By default, VS Code shows up to two recently updated external sessions.[^c-f304096a6b] Select a session from the Sessions list to view the conversation and continue it in VS Code with your Copilot subscription.[^c-6f3fec834e]

title: Rubber Duck (Experimental)
summary: Rubber Duck is an experimental feature that allows you to get a second opinion from a complementary model on the agent's work.[^c-c988377cda]

title: Single-pane side layout is now the default
summary: In the previous release, we introduced the single-pane layout.[^c-e211ed44af] In this layout, session details and editors are located in a single side pane, with a shared tab bar next to chat.[^c-f1dabf4308] The single-pane layout is now enabled by default for the Agents window on desktop.[^c-fc9fd06cd7]

title: Simplified session controls and information
summary: The session header is less crowded, so you can identify the active session more easily and focus on the conversation.[^c-0a003a3223] The session title has a prominent position, while an overflow menu next to the title groups actions for creating a chat and pinning the session.[^c-d8f4dc5900] Search remains available in the Sessions list.[^c-8e770d105f]

title: Editor-style sticky scroll for chat (Experimental)
summary: Chat sticky scroll lets you keep the current prompt visible as you scroll through and review long responses.[^c-40afcb2a2a]

title: Copilot code review: Resolution reasons and expanded capabilities
Better label management on issues is generally available
